Using the actual signed N_i^r Definition: h->x adds a with no higher slot, coefficient 1; h->y adds b with higher empty a, coefficient q; x->z adds b with higher occupied a, coefficient q^-1; y->z adds a with no higher slot, coefficient 1. All are terms of the linear endomorphism F_1:F->F, raising size by one and lowering weight by alpha_1; arrows do not assert equality to a full image.

Using the smaller-diagram N_i^l Definition: x->h has lower empty b giving q^-1; y->h has no lower slot giving 1; z->x removes b giving 1; z->y removes a above occupied b giving q. These match the prose top,left,right,bottom ordering.
